name: debug_directive_and_auto_roll_resolution
evaluator_instructions: Focus on whether debug setup is separated from player speech, whether the GM treats debug-created state as GM-only test context, and whether the system automatically plans, rolls, resolves, and persists mechanics after a fictional player action without asking for dice totals.

turns.user_input:
[debug]add {"id":"item.smartgun","kind":"weapon","damage":"4d6","owner":"pc","tags":["test_only"]}[/debug]
我检查手里的智能枪，确认它已经上膛，然后瞄准最近的威胁。
turns.notes: Debug-created weapon should not leak as debug metadata; player action remains human-like and action-only.

turns.user_input: 我用这把枪朝最近的敌人扣下扳机，射完马上缩回掩体。
turns.notes: The system should infer the attack, hydrate/use the debug-created weapon, roll automatically, and move to outcome or next player decision.
